notes.title: Refined Paths | Update 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Chapter Two is finally here with the Refined Paths update!

The developer has been hard at work, incorporating feedback from playtesters on the beta branch. This update brings tons of new features, bug fixes, and quality-of-life improvements throughout the game. It is also 40% off until August 15th. 

Let’s dive into what’s new!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517419/52120d98806fec713aaf27a8e03b5862818a6021.gif"]

 v1.0.5 Patch Notes

New Missions & Achievements – Take on fresh challenges and unlock brand-new achievements.

Player Health Mechanic – Manage your vitality with the newly introduced health system.

Visual Upgrades – Added enhanced visual effects to boxes and various models for a richer atmosphere.

New Research Area – Explore an all-new zone filled with hidden secrets to discover.

More Items & Devices – Expanded the arsenal with additional gear to find and use.

Revamped Menu UI – Updated the interface for smoother navigation.

Steam Drops – When you play, you’ll receive a drop after a certain amount of time. These drops include added lore for you to enjoy, and you can also sell them on the Steam Market to earn extra Steam credit — all while helping support our development ːsteamhappyː.

And Much More… – Plenty of smaller tweaks, fixes, and surprises await!

Please note that the Patch Notes may be updated in the future to include additional changes.

notes.title: Refined Paths — Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
We’re excited to announce that Refined Paths v1.0.5 will be releasing on Fri, Aug 8 at 7:30 AM PDT (9:30 AM CDT) with a 40% off discount! We hope you enjoy the new update once it’s out! :D


Note: If you’ve noticed the updates marketing assets (logos, banners, etc.) appearing throughout Steam, don’t worry — this doesn’t mean the update is live. It was just a publishing mistake on our part.

Cheers!

notes.title: Achievement Changes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
the achievements have all been changed with new names, descriptions and icons. We hope you like them. :)

Oh and we almost forgot, v1.0.3 should be out soon.

notes.title: Expected Release Date
notes.notes: Hello everyone! We expect to release The Void Corridors in just a couple of days. The game will launch with a 15% discount as part of the 2025 Steam Spring Sale. If you have any questions, feel free to comment!
